visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt and denim-style overalls, stands in a modern, well-lit kitchen area. She addresses the camera directly with a cheerful expression and uses frequent hand gestures to emphasize her points. The background features light wood cabinets and a stainless steel exhaust hood under bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene shifts to close-up shots of coffee preparation. Hands pour dark roasted coffee beans from a plastic container into a white grinder. Subsequently, a white swan-neck kettle is filled with a steady stream of water from a kitchen tap. The lighting is bright and clean, highlighting the textures of the beans and the flow of the water. (3) A screen recording of a smartphone displays a ChatGPT interface in Traditional Chinese. The text lists various food items and their estimated calorie counts, including items like yogurt, bananas, and black coffee. The user scrolls through the detailed nutritional breakdown provided by the AI assistant on a white digital background. (4) The woman is shown sitting, holding a white binder or photo album. She flips through pages that contain various printed photos and handwritten notes. She continues to speak to the camera, occasionally pointing at the contents of the album to illustrate her advice on using AI for personal analysis. (5) In a brief cutaway, a chef dressed in professional black attire and gloves is seen carving a whole roasted duck. The duck has a glistening, dark brown skin. Thin slices of meat are expertly removed and placed on a white platter as steam rises from the fresh dish in a restaurant setting. (6) The woman stands in front of a minimalist white wardrobe with large doors. She demonstrates body type analysis by holding up different colored knitted tops, such as a muted pink and a light blue patterned piece, against her torso to check the fit and style. (7) A close-up shot inside a drawer shows two hands holding and opening different makeup palettes. One palette contains nine shades of neutral and warm eyeshadows, while the other is a smaller four-shade compact. Various other cosmetic bottles and brushes are visible in the background of the drawer.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Point-by-point feature demonstration (Food, Feng Shui, Fashion, Language, etc.) -> Outro/Summary
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle tutorial and product showcase for ChatGPT, specifically focusing on its multimodal and analytical capabilities. The creator uses a list-based format to demonstrate ten practical daily applications, ranging from calorie counting and meal planning to wardrobe advice and interior design analysis. By showing physical examples in a scrapbook and real-world cutaways, the video aims to educate the audience on how AI can be integrated into everyday tasks to improve efficiency and personal styling.
